about: Shared cases for the screening rules. Both server/firewall.py and app/js/firewall.js must give these verdicts and reasons. 'why' is the assistant's explanation, which the wording rules read too. In 'text' and 'why', {{tags:...}} becomes invisible Unicode tag characters and {{U+XXXX}} becomes that code point, so this file stays plain ASCII. 'app_reported' is what the assistant's app reported (outside_content, none, not_reported); when it is missing, the store assumes not_reported. Only reserved example names (RFC 2606) are used.
